summary: Projects input points onto collision geometry by closest distance or by casting rays along point normals, with optional distance, normal, bounce, and group outputs.

key_params.name: normal
key_params.note: Source, collision, or reflected normal output

key_params.name: bouncegeo
key_params.note: Save projected geometry for each bounce

key_params.name: scale
key_params.note: Projection scale from source to intersection

key_params.name: jitter
key_params.note: Perturbation scale for extra sample rays

common_gotchas: Project Rays mode needs point normals; Minimum Distance mode does not.
Points that miss collision geometry can receive zero normal or distance values.
Higher bounces and sample counts increase geometry and cook cost.
Leave Transform Points off when only intersection attributes are needed.
key_concepts: Ray SOP projects one surface onto another for shrink-wrap, draping, and similar surface-conformance effects.
Minimum Distance mode ignores point normals, while Project Rays mode casts along source point normals.
It can move source points or only update intersection attributes such as normal and distance.
Bounce settings can re-project reflected rays and optionally save bounce geometry.
